Hi Jake,
My husband John left a enquiry on the Worldwide Entertainers.
I understand that there will be no problems for you contractually away from this site? I wouldn't want to I create any difficulties for you.
As you know , I really like your voice , and would like to book you to this occasion, if you are happy to accept the fee of £100. As I mentioned, this is a charity fundraising event. We will have several Mayor's and dignitaries from around Kent in attendance. You can tell me how you normally work , but we will not want music that will drown out the conversation. The event is advertised from 3pm to 5:30pm, so most will start arriving 2:30 ish
Let me know what you think!
Thank you
Eija Burrell

I'd suggest about 30–40 minutes of soft background music while people eat and chat, then 30–40 minutes more upbeat once the food, speeches and raffle are done.

I've got the event as Mayor of Dartford afternoon tea — please confirm the venue address when you can.

Thanks,
Jake
